about.metaDescription: The Methys story: how life in Copenhagen inspired a Greek founder to create menswear with clean lines and real character.
about.title: About us
about.intro: Years ago I moved from Greece to Copenhagen for work, knowing almost nothing about fashion. On its streets I saw people dressed with an effortless elegance — and I wanted that for myself. But I kept noticing small details I would change: “That jacket would be perfect in green.” “Those shoes need a thinner sole.” I had opinions, but no say in how the clothes were made. When I returned to Greece, I saw that this kind of everyday style was missing. That was the moment Methys began: a menswear brand that looks exactly the way I imagined it. I knew it might not work. I started it anyway — because trying is always worth it.
about.videoUnsupported: Your browser does not support the video tag.
about.imageAlt: Methys clothing laid out in the studio
about.story: It all began with one idea: style isn't just how you look — it's how you express yourself. Copenhagen taught me to dress with detail and purpose. Greece gave me the warmth and character I wanted every piece to carry. Methys brings the two together: menswear for men who want to look sharp every day and have the confidence to stand out.
